content.title: PENGU is the official coin of Pudgy Penguins.
content.description: Pudgy Penguins has become the face of crypto with one of the most influential communities in the industry. From large companies wearing the Penguin, to being featured in ETF commercials, to garnering millions of followers and over 100 billion views, the Pengu has become a cultural icon making PENGU the world’s social currency.

content.title: About Solana (SOL)
content.description: Solana is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain built for mass adoption, offering a fast and low-cost environment for decentralized applications.

content.title: About Monad
content.description: Monad is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain that processes 10,000 transactions per second with near-zero fees while maintaining complete compatibility with the Ethereum Virtual Machine.

content.title: About Vanar Chain (VANRY)
content.description: Vanar Chain is a carbon-neutral Layer 1 blockchain designed to bring mainstream entertainment and gaming sectors into Web3 through high-speed, low-cost infrastructure.

content.title: About Bitcoin (BTC)
content.description: Bitcoin is the world's first decentralized cryptocurrency that enables peer-to-peer electronic cash transactions without intermediaries like banks or governments.

content.title: About Pi Network (PI)
content.description: Pi Network is a social cryptocurrency and developer platform designed to make digital currency mining accessible to everyday people through mobile devices.

content.title: About TRUMP
content.description: TRUMP is a politics-themed digital coin built on the Solana blockchain that uses the brand of Donald Trump to foster a community-driven ecosystem.

content.title: About Arcium (ARX)
content.description: Arcium is a parallelized confidential computing network designed to provide a trustless and verifiable framework for executing computations on encrypted data without exposing it to the network.

content.title: About OpenGradient (OPG)
content.description: OpenGradient is a decentralized infrastructure network designed to host, inference, and verify artificial intelligence models onchain through a specialized coprocessor architecture.
